BECOME A FELLOW

Experience Israel.
Create Change. Transform Lives.

Join Yahel's community of changemakers building a more just and vibrant Israeli society through immersive service learning.

LEARN MORE
SUPPORT US

Live like you belong. Serve like it matters.

In a world of superficial encounters, Yahel offers something revolutionary: the chance to be truly needed. To contribute skills that communities actually want. To listen before acting. To build relationships that outlast your stay. This is responsible service that honors both the giver and receiver—creating the kind of change that endures long after you've returned home.

FROM VISITOR TO CHANGEMAKER

The Yahel Social Change Fellowship

Join a diverse cohort of fellows from around the world for 9 months of purposeful service in Israel's communities. Engage in meaningful volunteering, develop language skills, and gain professional experience while creating lasting social impact.

GET IN TOUCH
Our Volunteer Hubs
The establishment of our four regional volunteer hubs represents more than geographic growth — it reflects our commitment to building lasting infrastructure for meaningful service across Israel. Each hub serves as a center for volunteer coordination, community partnership, and social change leadership, enabling us to respond rapidly to immediate needs while advancing long-term community goals.
